notes.title: Ver 0.3.9 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Enemiy in this game is called Foe

- Foe may come in formation of 5
- Total health is determined by number of turns passed. Distributed fairly
- Player can select which foe is targeted for effects. Select again to deselect
- Wave ends when all foes destroyed
- Adjusted playflow
- Removed kill counter
- Fixed bugs
